methods.label: Robust
methods.plain: Looks at every pair of months, takes the middle rate of change, then asks how steadily the record moves in one direction. One freak month cannot bend it.
methods.science: Theil-Sen slope, Mann-Kendall test with lag-1 variance correction

methods.label: Classic straight line
methods.plain: Fits the straight line closest to all the months and tests its slope, allowing for the fact that a warm month is often followed by another warm month.
methods.science: Least squares, t-test with effective sample size

methods.label: Year by year
methods.plain: Averages each year into one value first, which removes most of the month-to-month memory, then fits a straight line through the yearly values.
methods.science: Least squares on annual means, t-test with effective sample size

methods.label: Textbook, no memory
methods.plain: The straight-line fit and test exactly as in a first statistics course. It treats every month as independent of the last one.
methods.caution: The air is not independent from month to month, so this method claims certainty too easily. It is here for comparison and does not count toward agreement.

checks.label: False-alarm control
checks.plain: Hundreds of places are tested at once, so some would pass by luck. We limit how many of the flagged ones can be false alarms.

checks.label: Second dataset
checks.plain: Where two independent datasets cover the same years and heights, a change is only "Clear" if both show it.
checks.science: Sign, significance and range overlap between AIRS and MERRA-2

checks.label: Volcano months
checks.plain: Every trend is recomputed without the months after big eruptions. If it changes by more than half, the label becomes "Disputed".

checks.label: Data-source jumps
checks.plain: If a record jumps at the moment its measuring instruments changed, and the jump explains much of the trend, the label becomes "Disputed".
checks.science: Two-year shift at documented changes against the 97.5th percentile of all shifts

auto.dataset: The satellite record if it measures this, otherwise the reanalysis.
auto.period: The years covered by two datasets if there are any, otherwise the full record.
